item.title: Apple Intelligence Arrives in China with iOS 27.3
item.description: Apple Intelligence launches in China via iOS 27.3 beta, powered by Alibaba’s Qwen model. Explore new AI tools, live translation, and more.

item.title: iOS 27.3 Beta 1 Brings Apple Intelligence to China
item.description: Apple rolls out iOS 27.3 beta 1 with Apple Intelligence features to Chinese beta testers, marking the first AI rollout outside the US in 2026.

item.title: iOS 27 Update: 5 Must‑Use iPhone Features Explained
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27 adds stability upgrades, faster app launches, AI‑driven shortcuts, and a Wallet slider—five features you can start using now today.

item.title: Apple Intelligence Boosts iPhone Shortcuts with AI
item.description: Apple Intelligence now powers iPhone Shortcuts, letting users create automations with natural‑language prompts on iOS 27 via Cloud Pro or On‑Device.

item.title: Apple Intelligence Doubles iPhone Storage on New Models
item.description: Apple Intelligence’s on‑device AI now uses nearly twice the storage of prior iPhone models, reshaping user expectations, app design, and device plans.

item.title: iOS 27 Unlocks AI Home Perks for iCloud+ Subscribers
item.description: Apple’s iOS 27 introduces AI-driven Home app features for iCloud+ 2TB+ subscribers, including video summaries and smart clip search.
